Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4116, Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5), mikekinney seat; did not write or refresh this PR.

## Result: CLEAN

This is a first review. I read the whole diff (3 files: tests and one decision file). No runtime code changes. The PR merges cleanly with upstream/main (de035b4). I built and tested the trial merge.

## Build and tests (local, trial merge with upstream/main)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 4 steps, 0 failed.
  - app build: ok
  - app lib: ok
  - `first_traverse_posed`: ok
  - `first_traverse_table_tilt`: ok
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --test first_traverse_table_tilt --test first_traverse_posed -- -D warnings`: pass.

## Mutations (I ran two of the three myself; both restored)
- Remove the cross-drill clause from `posed_kind`: `a_cross_drill_enters_the_posed_law_but_an_axial_drill_does_not` is RED.
- Make `table_top` use a zero origin for `PosedTurn::Line`: `the_fixed_table_reads_a_single_rotary_line_in_the_paths_height_scale` is RED. The older `the_fixed_table_reads_its_top_in_the_paths_height_scale` stays green, so the new test adds real coverage.

## Checks
- The new tests only add assertions. The existing safety assertions are unchanged.
- The posting test uses a synthetic long-flute cutter and states the rotary clearances. It does not remove a warning or weaken a check. It has a control: changing only the clearance removes the verdict and the program posts.
- No `testdata/`, post, operation, motion or catalog files changed. No golden or recorded program moved. Catalog and importer suites are not selected.
- No `crates/ui` change, so no screenshots are needed.
- No `build.rs`, scripts, `.github` or dependency change.
- Files stay under 400 lines (335 and 262). The decision file `docs/decisions/3145-posed-traverse-pins.md` is present. The body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3145`.

Extra suites run: none required (no test data or importer change).

Not run: heavy lanes and the light lane. The diff is test-only and does not reach them.

## Findings
None.

The author is not a collaborator, so the PR waits for a collaborator to approve and merge.
